description: This file defines utility enums and functions for handling command-line execution environment invocations, including parsing, unwrapping environment variable assignments, and handling wrapper commands like 'env'.

methods.name: basenameLower
methods.description: Returns the lowercase basename of a given token, after trimming whitespace and replacing directory separators.

methods.name: unwrap
methods.description: Unwraps the command array by removing environment wrappers if present.

methods.name: unwrapWithMetadata
methods.description: Unwraps command array and provides metadata about usage of modifiers.

methods.name: unwrapDispatchWrappersForResolution
methods.description: Recursively unwraps nested 'env' wrappers in command array for resolution.

methods.name: unwrapTransparentEnvInvocation
methods.description: Checks and unwraps transparent environment invocation commands.

methods.name: unwrapTransparentDispatchWrappersForResolution
methods.description: Recursively unwraps 'env' wrappers for transparent env invocations in command array.
